verses.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

xrefs.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens— He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
“Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.
And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.

verses.text: Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.

xrefs.text: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and void; I looked to the heavens, and they had no light.
When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.

For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens— He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.

verses.text: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

xrefs.text: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

verses.text: And God saw that the light was good, and He separated the light from the darkness.

to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.

verses.text: God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning— the first day.

xrefs.text: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.

For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.”

verses.text: And there was evening, and there was morning— the third day.

verses.text: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.” And it was so.

I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.
